purpose: Deterministic first-party mask-based visual QA. Source renders remain immutable review evidence; QA masks are derived evidence bound to the same capture identity.
principles: No external vision model, third-party image corpus, generated reference image or legacy V-series image may become a reference.
Capture mismatch is separate from model regression. Unequal camera/pose/frame/renderer/crop settings are not quantitatively compared.
Unsupported or absent detectors are UNKNOWN, never PASS.
Raw per-case measurements are retained; no aggregate quality score may hide a failing or unknown case.
Numerical visual QA never substitutes for owner anatomy acceptance.

mask_format.reason: Portable grayscale masks are parseable with Python standard library and avoid image-library dependencies.

mask_roles.subject: Body plus visible owned garment where applicable; required.
mask_roles.body: Underlying body if capture provider can produce it; otherwise UNKNOWN.
mask_roles.garment: Owned garment only for dressed captures; otherwise UNKNOWN.
mask_roles.hand_l: Left hand visibility mask when provider supports region masks.
mask_roles.hand_r: Right hand visibility mask when provider supports region masks.
mask_roles.foot_l: Left foot visibility mask when provider supports region masks.
mask_roles.foot_r: Right foot visibility mask when provider supports region masks.
mask_roles.equipment: Owned exercise equipment mask when present and provider supports it.

requirements: mask dimensions match source image dimensions

crop_visibility.rule: For masks marked expected_visible, empty mask is FAIL. For whole-body views with allow_edge_touch=false, any foreground on image edge is FAIL. Close-ups may explicitly allow edge touch.

connected_components.note: Record component count and largest-component ratio. No production threshold is created here.

horizontal_symmetry.scope: neutral front/rear subject masks only when a declared symmetry axis is supplied
horizontal_symmetry.note: Record mirrored XOR ratio, centroid offset and side occupancies; no anatomy PASS threshold is created here.

contact_visibility.note: Region/equipment mask pixel gap may be measured when both masks exist. Physical contact error remains authoritative from runtime/model contact evidence.

milestone_mapping.note: The existing 57-view plan defines model-side visual coverage planning only. Future runtime capture must bind its own exact frame/time and runtime commit.

controlled_fixture_policy.label: SYNTHETIC_TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY
controlled_fixture_policy.rule: Deliberately altered project-owned fixture masks may prove detector sensitivity. They are never review snapshots, references or production evidence.

reference_policy.replacement: A new reference is a new versioned reference record. Never overwrite or silently replace a pinned reference.
reference_policy.owner_review: pending references remain experimental and cannot be labelled accepted.
